newsitem.title: GREECE: Ionian Bank H1 pretax profit at 5.0bln drs.
newsitem.headline: Ionian Bank H1 pretax profit at 5.0bln drs.

text.p: Ionian Bank will post first half pretax profit in excess of 5.0 billion drachmas, its management told shareholders at Friday's annual general meeting.
Ionian posted pretax earnings of 2.1 billion drachmas in fiscal 1996, down from 13.6 billion in the previous year.

Ionian's governor Harris Stamatopoulos said 1997 marked a fresh start in the bank's development which will be finalised as soon as parent Commercial Bank reaches a decision whether to absorb or spin off Ionian.
Ionian is going through a clean-up of its asset portfolio and has recently opened three new branches without hiring new personnel.
Ionian did not pay a dividend for fiscal 1996.
Shareholders approved the distribution of three bonus shares per 10 outstanding. The stock goes ex-bonus June 30. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
